/bin/bash -lc "set +e
printf '%s\\n' '--- npm test ---'
npm test
printf 'exit=%s\\n' \""'$?"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- npm audit ---'
npm audit --json
printf 'exit=%s\\n' \""'$?"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- startup target ---'
if test -f src/main.js; then echo 'src/main.js exists'; else echo 'src/main.js is missing'; fi
printf '%s\\n' '--- runtime probes ---'
node -e \"import('./src/worker.js').then(async ({retriesEnabled,processJob})=>{ console.log('RETRIES_ENABLED=false =>', retriesEnabled({RETRIES_ENABLED:'false'})); let events=[]; const job={id:'j1',execute:async()=>{events.push('execute');return 'ok'}}; await processJob(job,{ack:async()=>events.push('ack')},{record:async()=>events.push('record')}); console.log('event order =>',events.join(' -> ')); }).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1})\"
printf 'probe exit=%s\\n' \""'$?"
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- npm scripts ---'
npm run 2>&1
printf 'exit=%s\\n' \""'$?"'
